detail.longDescription: 2004: Software ran locally, you owned it. 2026: $90/yr across 6 apps for reminders & habits? Pure rent trap. Stop renting basic utilities. tranvas.com: fast, unified life OS. No bloat, AI, or paywalls. Runs 100% local, client-side WebAssembly. Zero telemetry, zero cookies. Your data, your control. Boost if you're over software landlords! Available for free here: https:// tranvas.com/?ref=masto_8536 # Productivity # LifeOS # IndieDev # OpenWeb
